home.ribbon: How Well Do You Know the Signs of Stroke? Play & Find Out!
home.disclaimer: This is a public awareness tool that helps to recognize, when emergency action may be needed. It does not provide a medical diagnosis. During an emergency situation immediately call 112/108.

balance.title: BALANCE LOSS
balance.text: Sudden loss of balance, dizziness or coordination
balance.questionEmphasis: loss of balance, dizziness or difficulty coordinating his movements.
balance.incorrectText: Sudden loss of balance or poor coordination, dizziness or trouble in walking can be a warning sign of stroke. Look for urgent medical attention
balance.successText: Sudden loss of balance or poor coordination, dizziness or trouble in walking can be a warning sign of stroke.

eye.title: Eye (Vision) Changes
eye.text: Sudden trouble seeing in one or both eyes
eye.questionEmphasis: blurred or double vision, or difficulty seeing
eye.incorrectText: Sudden blurred/double vision or difficulty seeing can be a warning sign of stroke. Look for urgent medical attention
eye.successText: Sudden blurred or double vision, or difficulty seeing in one or both eyes can be a warning sign of stroke.

face.title: FACE DROOPING
face.text: Sudden weakness or numbness of the face or uneven face.
face.incorrectText: Drooping downward on one side of the face can be a sign of stroke. Look for urgent medical attention
face.successText: Sudden drooping or weakness on one side of the face can be a warning sign of stroke.

arm.title: ARM WEAKNESS
arm.text: Sudden weakness numbness in one or both arms
arm.questionEmphasis: weakness or numbness in one arm this morning.
arm.incorrectText: Sudden weakness or numbness in one arm can be a warning sign of stroke. Look for urgent medical attention
arm.successText: Sudden weakness or numbness in one arm can be a warning sign of stroke.

speech.title: SPEECH DIFFICULTY
speech.text: Difficulty in Speaking or slurring of speech
speech.incorrectText: Sudden trouble in speaking or understanding speech may be a sign of stroke. Look for urgent medical attention
speech.successText: Sudden difficulty speaking, slurred speech or trouble understanding speech can be a warning sign of stroke.

emergency.title: TIME TO CALL EMERGENCY SERVICE
emergency.question:
Time is Gold.
Call emergency services immediately.
emergency.message: Every minute matters. Recognize even one sign of stroke and call 112/108 immediately. The sooner treatment begins, the greater the chance of survival and the lower the risk of lasting disability.

thanks.heading: Thanks for your Participation!
thanks.message: You’ve taken an important step towards a stroke-free tomorrow.
thanks.disclaimer1: This initiative and its gamification tool are intended solely for stroke awareness and educational purposes.
thanks.disclaimer2: The tool is designed to help participants learn and remember common warning signs of stroke and does not constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
thanks.disclaimer3: It is not intended to replace evaluation by a qualified healthcare professional.
thanks.disclaimer4: If you or someone else experiences symptoms suggestive of a stroke, seek immediate emergency medical assistance and consult a qualified healthcare professional.
thanks.disclaimer5: Do not rely on this educational tool to diagnose or rule out a stroke.
thanks.availableAt: *Available at: American Stroke Association. B.E.F.A.S.T. warning signs. Stroke.org.
